result.justification: The objectives are stated, but the methodology lacks some important details such as sample size and controls, which makes the connection between the research question and methods partial.

objective_evidence.quote: This manuscript describes 2 years of SARS-CoV-2 wastewater data from these counties and compares the wastewater SARS-CoV-2 signal with publicly reported COVID-19 case data from the same counties.

method_evidence.quote: WWTP staff collected 24-h composite influent wastewater samples 1 or 2 times per week.
